details.uk: As part of the infrastructure restoration project, 69 windows (totaling 179.06 m²) were replaced. The scope of work included demolition, the application of water-repellent sealing tape at joints, the installation of external sills and internal windowsills, and the finishing of both internal and external reveals.

details.uk: As part of the infrastructure restoration initiative, 76 windows (totaling 210.65 m²) were replaced. details.en: As part of the infrastructure restoration initiative, 76 windows (totaling 210.65 m²) were replaced.
